<thought>Using the most intense ESI‑MS peak (m/z 262.0994) as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈261.092 Da. A formula that matches this mass and the observed isotopic pattern (≈19 % M+1 suggesting ~15–18 carbons and a modest M+2 peak consistent with one sulfur) is C₁₅H₁₇O₂S, whose calculated exact mass is 261.0949 Da, within typical instrument tolerance.</thought>
<final_answer>C15H17O2S</final_answer>
